title: The Nash Nook | Private Roof Terrace + City Views
description:
For guests who love good music and good drinks—this SoBro condo escape gives you a stylish place to land with modern comfort and boutique vibes, complete with a king bed, cozy loft, sleeper sofa, full kitchen, and a glass garage door that opens to your private rooftop terrace. It’s made for golden-hour hangs, skyline selfies, and late-night stories under the city lights. Only one mile from Broadway, you’re close to the energy but far enough to relax when the night winds down.

Permit #2025104452

The space
Welcome to The Nash Nook, a stylish SoBro escape featuring a huge private terrace with stunning city views. Just a short walk or quick Uber to Broadway (1 mile), you’re perfectly placed to enjoy the best of Nashville.

Guest access
Access to the entire condo and private spacious terrace.
